title: Deferred web view delete outlives the account slot and can wipe the data of the next sign-in under the same key
trigger: Account-1 logs out while its mini app helper is open (delete waits on helper_gone); the user signs in again as account-1 and opens a mini app; the old helper then exits
effect: remove_dir_all(webview_dir) removes the new session's live web view folder and store-salt.key, so its mini app storage vanishes and the store id changes mid-session
fix: Key the deferred delete by an owner generation (the salt value read at forget time) and delete only if the folder still holds that salt.

title: 'Code sent to' marker is cleared before the in-flight guard can refuse the request
trigger: A 2FA op is in flight (password_state_loading); user presses Forgot password / sets a login email / retries.
effect: request_twofa_recovery_code (463) and set_login_email (521) set twofa_flow.*_sent_to = None, then password_op_send returns InvalidRequest. The emailed code is still valid but the dialog drops back from the code step to the start step.
fix: Clear the marker in the answer/ack arm (or in a Sending stage) only after the request was accepted.

title: Password sign-in, recovery request and recovery code submit have no in-flight guard
trigger: On the 2FA sign-in screen press Enter/click twice on 'Forgot password?' (or submit on a slow link).
effect: submit_password, request_password_recovery and submit_recovery_code (unlike login_request/submit_phone) never check has_purpose/has_auth_submit; a double click sends two recovery e-mails (2nd answers 429 into last_auth_error), the UI sets recovery_mode before any answer.
fix: Route all three through login_request (one request per purpose) and set recovery_mode only on the answer.

title: Old save answer overwrites served and clears failed of a newer pick
trigger: Save A (serial 1), pick B and close panel (serial 2 fails), answer for serial 1 arrives late
effect: save_answer applies Ok(saved) to served and failed = None even when the ticket serial is not the one in flight, so the failed pick can be sent again
fix: Apply Ok/Err to served/failed only when the ticket serial equals the saving serial; otherwise only update served from the session.

title: Registry read-modify-write is not serialized: two writers lose one update
trigger: add_account on one thread while another thread runs set_active_account/begin_remove_account/set_notify_from_all (each does load_registry, edit, save_registry with no lock held across the three steps)
effect: the second save overwrites the first: a new account or a pending delete silently disappears
fix: One `update_registry(app_root, |&mut AccountRegistry|)` that holds a mutex across load and save; the other functions call it.

title: A failed create_dir_all drops the user's recent hashtags instead of keeping them
trigger: an earlier build left recent_hashtags.json in the app folder, the primary account is registered but its folder cannot be created (read-only, full disk); start Quill
effect: `registered && create_dir_all.is_ok() && let Err = move_item` is false when create_dir_all fails, so control falls to remove_any(&stray) and deletes the only copy of the list
fix: Return early (keep the stray) when the owner folder cannot be created; only remove the stray when the account is gone or already has its own list.

title: If the writer thread cannot start, a submit that raced in is left unwritten until the next submit or quit
trigger: Thread spawn fails (resource limit) while a second pref change is submitted between the flag set and the reset
effect: submit A sets writer_running=true and fails to spawn; submit B (before A resets) sees running=true and returns without spawning; A then sets running=false. B's bytes sit queued with no writer; a crash before quit loses both
fix: Make spawn failure and the flag one step under the same lock, or let the next lock holder notice has_work() && !writer_running and spawn.

title: A panic inside the sink leaves writer_running true for the rest of the process
trigger: A sink panic on the quill-settings-writer thread (e.g. a panicking filesystem shim or OOM unwind) while a write is queued
effect: drain() never resets writer_running on unwind, so later submit() calls see running=true, never spawn a writer, and nothing is written; flush() at quit waits the full 10 s stall budget then gives up, losing every setting changed after the panic
fix: Reset writer_running in a drop guard inside drain(), or hold the thread as an enum Writer::Running(JoinHandle) and check is_finished on submit.

title: A failed settings write is reported once and then not retried until some unrelated submit or quit
trigger: Disk full: change a pref, see the one note, free space, change nothing else
effect: Queued::failed stays true; nothing retries it on a timer, so the pref exists only in memory and the queue until another submit/flush; a crash in between loses it
fix: Make Failed a retry stage with a backoff owned by the writer (manual clock in tests) instead of waiting for an outside submit.

title: If recording 'started' fails, the next launch treats the new install as an upgrade and skips onboarding
trigger: Read-only or full app data folder on first launch; TDLib then creates its database; relaunch
effect: save(app_root,false) error is ignored, the file is missing, database_exists() is true, so first_run_pending marks done and returns false
fix: Surface the write error, or decide 'upgrade' from a version marker rather than from the database existing.

title: A failed window_state.json write drops the staged geometry
trigger: Disk full or read-only data folder; move the window; free the space; do not move it again
effect: write_staged takes() the staged state before writing and ignores the error (`let _ =`), so nothing remains staged to retry and no failure note is raised; the next launch opens the window at the old place
fix: Put the state back (or keep it staged until the write is Ok) and report through take_deferred_write_failure.

title: The accept answer clears a newer updateTermsOfService that arrived while accepting
trigger: Accept terms A; before the ok answer, the server pushes updateTermsOfService for terms B
effect: session_apply_ok sets terms=None on any AcceptTermsOfService ok, so B is dropped and the user is never asked for it this session
fix: Accepting { id } and clear terms only when the current terms id equals the one accepted.

title: review_pending sticks above zero when a send fails partway through several sessions
trigger: Banner shows 2+ unconfirmed sessions; user presses Yes; send_json fails on a session that is not the last (client closing)
effect: review_unconfirmed_sessions sets review_pending = ids.len(), then on a send failure calls finish_login_review once (decrement 1) and returns Err, so the ids never sent are never answered; review_pending stays >0, the banner buttons stay busy and review_unconfirmed_sessions refuses (InvalidRequest) until the session ends
fix: Set review_pending only to the number of requests actually sent (increment per send), or use the Reviewing { remaining } enum and drop unsent ids on failure.

title: An envelope dropped as out-of-order is dropped before its pending request is taken, so the request and its download count leak
trigger: An answer arrives with seq <= last_seq (reader reorder or seq reset) for a mutation or a DownloadFile request.
effect: The request stays in RequestRegistry.pending forever (only sweepable lookups are swept); for a download has_download() stays true so the file is never asked again, and its spinner never clears.
fix: Take the pending request first and settle it (as lost) when the envelope is ignored, or do not drop answers by seq at all.

title: SellGift ok clears the selected gift and convert box whatever is selected now
trigger: Sell a gift, then before the ok lands select another gift in the hub.
effect: The newly selected gift's panel and convert confirm are closed by the old gift's answer.
fix: Clear gift_selected only when it equals the gift the request carried.

title: SetCloseFriends ok applies whatever ids are staged, not the ids of the request that was acknowledged
trigger: Edit close friends and save, then save again with other ids before the first ok lands (the story editor stays usable).
effect: The first ok takes the second save's staged ids as confirmed; if the second fails the list shows ids the server does not have.
fix: Carry the ids on the pending request (story_ids, as ReorderStoryAlbums does) and apply those.

title: createCall answer is ignored when another call is already tracked, leaving the created outgoing call with no owner
trigger: Press Call and, before the callId answer lands, an incoming call from another user arrives and becomes active_call.
effect: The outgoing call exists on the server but is never tracked: its updateCall is ignored as an untracked outgoing id, so it cannot be hung up and rings the callee to timeout.
fix: On a callId answer with a busy slot, discardCall the created id (or queue it in busy_decline_queue).

title: Switching to another chat takes open_topic without releasing the old topic history
trigger: Open a forum topic in chat A, click chat B in the list.
effect: select_chat does open_topic.take() but release_topic_history only when previous == chat_id, so the left topic's history is never queued for trimming and stays at full length until the closed-chat bound evicts it (memory only).
fix: Release the taken topic against the previous chat id in every case, as deselect_topic does.

title: is_offline is true for Initial while connection_indicator shows nothing
trigger: Start the app and send or place a call before the first updateConnectionState arrives.
effect: Sends and calls are refused as offline (is_offline matches only Ready and Updating) with no connection strip drawn, so the person sees an offline error and an apparently connected app.
fix: Define both functions from one match on ConnectionState so Initial is the same answer in each (not offline, or shown as Connecting).

title: A deleted direct-messages conversation keeps its message count, revenue and banned flags
trigger: Delete a conversation in a channel's direct messages, then a new conversation with the same topic id is not reused but the maps grow; if TDLib reuses the id its old count shows until a page answers.
effect: forget_direct_topic removes only topics[chat][topic] and the open marker; message_counts and revenue (keyed by chat and topic) stay, so a stale N messages can show for a returning topic id.
fix: Key all per-conversation values inside the topic entry so removing the entry removes them.

title: draft_dirty is set before the save and cleared only when a send succeeds
trigger: Type in a chat so mark_draft_dirty runs, then have send_draft fail (sender closed, rich input missing) and stay away from that composer.
effect: The dirty key stays in messages.draft_dirty, so set_remote_draft, updateNewChat and thread info skip every remote draft for that slot (a draft written on another device never shows) until a later save succeeds.
fix: Make the draft slot an enum (Clean, Dirty, Saving(RequestId)) and settle it on the error arm and when the composer leaves the slot.

title: Supergroup member counts and profile facts are dropped when the full info is not stored yet
trigger: A supergroupFullInfo answer where the full-info record is created after set_supergroup_member_counts runs, or an update arrives before the first full info (groups/apply.rs:131).
effect: set_supergroup_member_counts and set_supergroup_profile_facts use get_mut and silently do nothing, so the permissions box shows zero restricted/banned counts until the next full-info update.
fix: Store the counts in the same step that creates the full info, or make the setters create the entry.

title: Groups-in-common pages are matched by a loading_more bool, not by request id
trigger: Open a user's profile, scroll to load the second page of groups in common, close and reopen the profile (fetch_profile_chats resets paging) before the second page answers.
effect: The old page-2 answer sees loading_more=false and replaces the whole list with page 2 only; or the old failure turns the list to Failed. The list is wrong until the profile is reopened.
fix: ProfileChatsFetch::Loaded { ids, more: MorePage::{Idle, Loading(RequestId), Exhausted} } and compare the pending id.

title: A failed refresh of a profile chat list replaces an already loaded list with Failed
trigger: Open a channel profile (similar channels loaded), reopen it so fetch_profile_chats sets Loading, and make the request fail.
effect: fail_profile_fetch inserts ProfileChatsFetch::Failed for the key regardless of what the list held; the earlier list is lost. (fetch_profile_chats itself writes Loading over Loaded first, so the earlier list is already hidden.)
fix: Keep the stale Loaded value inside Refreshing/Failed variants.

title: getProxies answer matched by purpose, not by request id; explicit refresh does not dedupe an in-flight fetch
trigger: Open the proxy list (fetch_proxies sends getProxies without checking has_purpose) while a fetch or a mutation's refetch is already out, then add a proxy
effect: The first answer clears loading and stale although a second request is still out, or an answer sent before the mutation lands after stale=true and clears it, so the list shows the pre-change proxies until the next change
fix: Fetch<T> carrying the RequestId of the getProxies it waits for; apply an answer only when its id is the current one, and let a mutation answer re-arm the refetch after it.

title: mutating is a bool, so the first of two overlapping proxy mutations clears it
trigger: Press Enable on one proxy and, before TDLib answers, Remove another (both purpose MutateProxy).
effect: The first answer sets mutating=false while the second is in flight, so the list controls re-enable and the first success marks the list stale and refetches while the second mutation may still be pending.
fix: Count by request id (Saving(Vec<RequestId>)) or serialize mutations.

title: Similar-channels strip state outlives the membership
trigger: Join a channel (strip inserted with expanded=true), leave it and open it again within the same session.
effect: similar_strips keeps the old joined_at notice and expanded flag for the chat id; the 'You joined this channel' row shows although the user left and is not a member (joined_at is only replaced by a new join).
fix: Remove the strip when the member status becomes Left/Banned or the chat is forgotten (history_prune).
